0.description: Pending Restart: Titan Scroll (World Buff) visual can now be turned off with .chatsetting command.
Implemented performance improvements!
[Requires Restart] Changed Titan Scroll Visual to something less flashbang
Fixed an issue where experience would end up mismatch between party members.
Fixed an issue where some players were not receiving their riding tome on Prestige.
Prestige Players on area-52 will no longer get a short temporary character-lock. [Pending Restart]
You can no longer delete Hand of Fates.
Added Uncommon loot templates to all leveling dungeons to smooth out the leveling experience and ensure players can gear up fully by doing dungeons while leveling.
Prestiging will now remove your pets to prevent an issue where people could keep high level pets. We'll improve this in the future to delevel pets you have properly.
Increased the chance to draft rare abilities.
Increased Rare Skill Card drop chance.

5.description: Fixed an issue where certain Bloodforged items such as Enumerated Bracers or items from your random satchel from dungeon or battlegrounds could roll without any stats. This fix will only apply to newly obtained items post restart.

6.description: [Serpentshrine Cavern] Pending Restarts: Underbog Colossus Fatal Infection ability now applies stacks every 3 seconds up from 1 second. Damage is still applied per second.
Pending Restarts: Reduced the duration of a number of "Banish" type spells used by various creatures.
[Blackrock Spire] [Pyroguard Emberseer] When the encounter starts, all player are now summoned inside Pyroguard Emberseers room.
[Blackrock Spire] [Pyroguard Emberseer] Pyroguard Emberseer will now join combat earlier when all Incarcerators are defeated.

[Blackrock Spire] [Pyroguard Emberseer] Pyroguard Emberseer now requires a single player to use his altar in order to start the encounter. Previously required every player in the instance to use and channel the altar.

0.description: Doubled the Experience gain from completing a Battleground!
Temporarily removed effects from Preparation in BGs while we address some bugs with it!
RAF Level granting is now disabled in Battlegrounds.
1v1 Honorable Combat Zones should now rotate properly at max level.
Players queued for LFG will no longer incur EXP degradation for being carried by higher level players. This was causing weird EXP issues in BRD where the level range is huge.
Fixed an issue where players could queue for a battleground and outlevel the bracket and still get into the battleground. They will now be removed from the queue when exceeding the bracket.

Fixed an issue where Fear (Shaken) and Fear (Mass Hysteria) had the incorrect range and cast time. [Pending restart]

6.description: [Blackrock Spire] Pending Restarts: Upper Blackrock Spire and Lower Blackrock Spire are now balanced separately from each other. Lower Blackrock Spire is considered a 5 player dungeon. Upper Blackrock Spire is considered a 15 player dungeon.
[Scholomance] [Kirtonos the Herald] Pending Restarts: Corrected an issue where Kirtonos the Herald would drop no loot and immediately despawn upon death.

0.description: Extra rage and energy bars will now be enabled by default.
Fixed an issue where taking damage from damage over time effects while out of combat would cancel drinking and eating. [Pending restart]
[Alar] Removed Felforged Tome from Vanity collection as people were unlocking it by proxy and were unable to use it.

Fixed an issue where Feathered Arrows would have no level requirement, yet add up to 9 DPS to your ranged weapon, the equivalent of a level 40 arrow. These arrows now require you to be level 35 to equip them.
[Alar] Pending Restarts: City Guards are now immune to Mind-control and similar effects.
[Alar] Pending Restarts: Faction Leader no longer follow the parry hasten rules.
[Alar] Pending Restarts: Corrected an issue where High Tinker Mekkatorgue had false expansion stats.
[Alar] Pending Restarts: All faction leader and city guards now ignore stealth, invisibility and feign death.
[Alar] Pending Restarts: Corrected multiple issues where city guards had no visible ranged weapons.
[Alar] Pending Restarts: Corrected multiple issues where city guards spawned with false expansion stats.

[Alar] Pending Restarts: Reduced the health and melee damage of faction leaders.

[Requires Restart] fixed an issue where level 1s could not properly reroll enchants.
Aura of Experience and RAF do not benefit players in Battlegrounds anymore.
You can no longer use Aura of Experience at max level to avoid using it when you did not mean to!
Battlegrounds now reward EXP on end to encourage actually doing the objectvies in the Battleground.

The damage from the Whispers of the Old Gods tentacle now deals 30% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Fixed an issue where Biting Cold would not correctly reduce the cooldown of Deep Freeze. [Pending restart]
